tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yum gyi mdo'i 'gres rkang gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru ār+ya mañdzu shrī ye/ smra ba'i skyes mchog ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /gang de'i rgyal tshab mi pham chos kyi rje/ /shing rta chen po thogs med sku mched dang*/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras la btud nas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab gzhan dang sher phyin gyi/ /brjod bya kun byang chos kyi khyad par 'ga'/ /gzhung mang dag la ring du 'dris pa'i blos/ /mkhas pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin bshad par bya/ /de la 'dir rgyal ba'i yum las gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar kun byang gi chos kyi dbye ba mang du bshad pa de dag gi mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs ji ltar yin pa'i dgongs pa rgyas par phye ste bkra na rang la phan yon chen por 'gyur bas legs mod/ 'on kyang mang du dogs pas bsdus nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang 'gres rkang brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstan pa rnams bsdu na gnyis su 'du ste/ kun nas nyon mongs phyogs dang*/ /rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi chos gnyis so/ /dang po la lnga bcu rtsa gsum ste/ gzugs phung sogs phung bo lnga/ mig sogs dbang bo drug /gzugs sogs yul drug /mig gi rnam par shes pa sogs rnam shes drug /mig gi 'dus te reg pa sogs reg pa drug /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba sogs tshor ba drug /sa sogs khams drug ma rig pa sogs rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis so/ /de dag rim par bshad na/ dang po phung bo la gsum/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ blo yul du spungs pa ltar snang ba'am 'dus pa ste phung bo'i don no/ /dbye na lnga ste/ gzugs kyi phung bo/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed/ rnam shes kyi phung bo'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po la/ spyir gzugs su rung ba ni/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ 'jug pa las/ gzugs rung mtshan nyid can ni gzugs/ zhes so/ /gzhan bzhi la'ang*/ tshor ba myong ba'i bdag nyid can/ /'du shes mtshan mar 'dzin pa ste/

/'du byed mngon par 'du byed pa'o/ /yul ni so sor rnam rig pa/ /rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ phung bo'i don ni sngar bzhin sbyar bar bya'o/ /dbye na/ 'byung ba dang*/ 'byung gyur gyi gzugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa chu me rlung ste bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa 'byung gyur la kha dog dang dbyibs dang de las gzhan pa'i gzugs gsum ste/ dang po ni rtsa ba dang yan lag gi kha dog dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ ring thung sogs kyi dbyibs dang*/ gsum pa ni/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang bo gzugs can rnams dang*/ sgra dri ro rnams dang gzugs dang reg bya gnyis kyi phyogs gcig rnams 'byung 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ myong bya bde sdug sogs rnam smin dngos btags ci rigs myong bas rab tu phye ba'i sems byung de/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'di la gang gis myong byed dang gang myong bya dang ji ltar myong tshul gsum gyis shes par bya zhing*/ tshor ba dngos ni de gsum las gang gis myong bar byed pa ste/ gzhan la'ang ci ltar rig par shes par bya'o/ /dbye na bde sdug bar ma gsum ci rigs ma 'dres par myong byed kyi tshor ba gsum mo/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yul dang dbang bo dang rnam shes gsum 'dus te yul gyi spu ris mi 'dra ba'i mtshan ma 'dzin pas rab tu phye ba'i sems byung te/ 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ 'di dang 'og ma gnyis te gsum la'ang byed pa po dang bya ba dang byed pa gsum gsum gyi sgo nas shes par bya'o/ /dbye na rtogs bcas rtog med kyi 'du shes gnyis las/ dang po ni/ so skye'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du gyur pa'i rtog pa'i 'du shes rags pa rnams phal cher te/ 'di dang 'di'o zhes mthong thos bye brag 'byed pa'i shes pa rnams so/ /'on kyang brda mi shes pa'i byis pa'i 'du shes ni rtog med kyi phyogs su 'du bar mdzad do/

/rtog med kyi 'du shes ni/ 'di dang 'di'o snyam du mi rtog pa don dam mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes rnams dang bsam gtan gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug rnams so/ /bzhi ba la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ phung bo gzhan bzhi gang rung las gzhan pa'i 'dus byas de/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na mtshungs ldan 'du byed dang*/ ldan min 'du byed gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems yul la g.yo bar byed pa'i sems byung rnams dang*/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi las rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni gzugs dang sems sogs skye 'jig gnas gsum byed pa'i gnas skabs la bzhag pa'i dus byas te/ skye rga na 'chi mi rtag 'jig pa sogs lta bu'o/ /lnga pa la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rang gi yul gyi ngo bo la dmigs pas rab tu phye ba'i rnam rig de/ rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos shes pa'i rnam par shes pa drug go /gsum pa la go rim sogs yod kyang 'dir dgos pa tsam bshad na/ phung bo lngar bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'khrul ba skye ba'i gzhir phung bo lngar nges la/ phung bo lnga'i dbye ba legs par shes na phung bo gang zag gi bdag tu 'khrul pa'i blo ldog par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ phung bo lnga so so nas kyang bdag tu 'khrul ba skye ba'i gzhi yin te/ mig sogs dbang bo lngas yul la longs spyod pa na/ gzugs la lta ba po'i gang zag gi bdag yod par 'khrul/ tshor ba gsum la sred pa gsum gyis longs spyod pa na rnam smin myong ba po'i gang zag gi bdag yod par 'khrul/ 'du shes kyis mthong thos bye brag 'byed pa'i sgo nas tha snyad 'dogs pa na tha snyad 'dogs pa po'i rang dbang ba'i bdag yod par 'khrul/ 'du byed kyi las dkar nag gsog cing skye rga na 'chi dang 'gro 'dug sogs byed pa na de gsog pa po dang skye ba po sogs dang*/ 'gro 'dug sogs byed pa po'i gang zag gi bdag yod par 'khrul/

sems sems byung skye ba na de'i gnas rnam par shes pa la rtag pa'i bdag tu 'khrul ba'i blo skye ba'i phyir/ blo de rnams ldog tshul yod de/ phung bo phan tshun brten nas bzhag pa'i chos tsam du shes pas de ldog par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang phung bo lnga bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ gzugs dang sems sems byung la ril bo gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rmongs pa rnam par bzlog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du 'chad par 'gyur ba gzhan dag la'ang dgos pa re yod pa shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbang bo bshad pa la gnyis/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ / dang po ni/ rang 'bras rnam shes bskyed pa la dbang byed pa'i 'dus byas zhig skabs 'di'i dbang bo'i don no/ /dbye na drug ste/ mig gi dbang bo/ rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus/ yid kyi dbang bo'o/ /dang po la/ rang 'bras mig gi rnam par shes pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa la dbang byed pa'i gzugs can dang ba ni/ mig gi dbang bo'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo mig gi kham sogs kyang des mtshon nus/ de yang me long dang ba'i nang du gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin du mig gi dbang bo de ni kha dog sogs kyi gzugs brnyan 'char du rung ba'i gzugs can dang ba zhig go /rna ba'i dbang po sogs kyi mtshan nyid la/ rang 'bras rna ba'i rnam shes kyi zhes sogs dang*/ rang 'bras sna'i sogs dang*/ de bzhin du lce dang lus la sbyar bar bya'o/ /yid kyi dbang bo'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang 'bras yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa la dbang byed pa'i 'dus byas zhig go /bye brag smra bas mig gi dbang bo ni mig gi 'bras bu la go snyod kyi me tog ltar gnas pa rgun 'brum tsam pa shin du dang ba zhig dang*/ rna ba'i dbang po ni/ rna la gro ga bcus pa lta bu'i rnam pa dang*/ sna dbang rgya khab gshibs pa lta bu/ lce dbang ni lce la zla ba phyed pa lta bu dang*/

lus dbang ni lus kyi cha rnams la rdul phran ltar gnas par 'dod do/ kha cig sems tsam pas mig dbang de mig shes bskyed pa la dbang byed pa'i nus pa zhig la 'dod ces gsungs yang*/ rang lugs gong du bshad pa ltar yid dbang ma gtogs 'byung gyur gyi gzugs shin du dang ba ste/ rgyal tshab rje dang mngon pa kun btus kyi dgongs pa'o/ /'o na/ mig dang mig dbang dang mig gi khams dang mig gi skye mched rnams 'gal lam zhe na/ kun btus dang ṭika ltar na mi 'gal te/ mig lta bus rnam shes bskyed par dbang ba dang 'dzin pa dang skyed pa'i sgo nas rim pa bzhin du dbang bo dang khams dang skye mched du bzhag ste/ gzhan dang lnga la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /bye brag smra bas mig dbang gis gzugs mthong gi /mig shes kho nas mi mthong zhes 'dod kyang*/ 'dir gnyis kas gzugs mthong zhing*/ de yang mig dbang la snang ba tsam gyi sgo nas mthong bar bzhag la/ mig shes kyis ni gzugs kyi rnam pa shar te/ gzung ba'i sgo nas rtogs so/ /'di drug dang gzugs sogs yul drug la skye mched bcu gnyis zhes kyang bya'o/ /gsum pa yul gzugs sogs la gnyis/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbyai ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang bo la brten nas rnam shes kyis rig par bya ba ste/ 'dir yul gyi don no/ /dbye na drug ste/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ /reg bya/ chos so/ /dang po la/ skabs 'di'i gzugs ni gzugs kyi skye mched la dgongs pas de'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang 'dzin mig shes kyi yul gtso bor gyur ba'i phyi'i skye mched do/ /dbye na kha dog dang dbyibs gzugs gnyis yod/ rang 'dzin nyan shes kyis go bar bya ba'i mnyan bya/ sgra'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra gnyis/ rang 'dzin sna shes kyis snom bya/ dri'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na zhim mi zhim gnyis/ rang 'dzin lce shes kyis myang bya/ ro'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na mngar ba/ skyur ba/ kha ba/ ska ba/

tshwa ba/ lan tshwa ba dang drug rang 'dzin lus shes kyis reg bya/ reg bya'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu gcig ste/ 'byung bzhi'i reg bya bzhi dang*/ 'jam rtsub/ lci yang*/ bkres skom/ grang ba ste 'byung gyur gyi reg bya bdun no/ /yid shes kyi yul gtso bor gyur ba ni/ 'dir chos te/ dbye na/ 'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos gnyis so/ /bzhi ba rnam shes la/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yul gyi ngo bo la dmigs pa tsam gyis rab tu phye ba'i rnam par rig pa ste/ rnam shes kyi don no/ /'di la shes bya shes byed shes tshul gsum gyis rig par bya'o/ /dbye na drug ste/ mig gi rnam shes rna ba sna lce lus yid kyi rnam shes so/ /rang gi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen mig dbang bo la brten nas yul gzugs kyi ngo bo la dmigs pa tsam gyi rab tu phye ba'i rigs gnas kyi rnam par rig pa de/ mig gi rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du rang gi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen rna ba sna lce lus yid dbang la brten nas yul sgra dri ro reg bya chos la dmigs pas rab tu phye ba'i rigs gnas kyi rnam rig rnams/ rim pa bzhin du rna ba sna lce lus yid kyi rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid do/ /lnga ba reg pa la/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yul dang dbang bo dang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas yul gyi 'gyur ba dang por gcod pa'i sems byung ste/ 'dir reg pa'i don no/ /'di la gang gis reg pa dang*/ gang la reg pa dang ji ltar reg pa gsum gyis shes par bya'o/ /dbye na drug ste/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa nas yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i bar ro/ / gzugs dang mig dbang dang mig gi rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas yul gyi 'gyur ba dang por gcod pa'i sems byung de mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du sgra rna ba de'i rnam shes/ /dri sna de'i rnam shes/

ro lce de'i rnam shes/ reg bya lus de'i rnam shes/ chos yid de'i rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas zhes sogs sngar bzhin sbyar te/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa nas yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i bar gyi mtshan nyid do/ /yul gyi 'gyur ba ni tshor bas myong ba dang mthun pa'i bde sdug sogs so/ /drug pa tshor ba la/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni sngar ltar ram yang na/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas reg pas bcad pa dang mthun pa'i yul nyams su myong ba'i sems byung ste/ 'dir tshor ba'i don ldog go /'di la'ang tshor byed dang tshor bya dang ji ltar tshor ba gsum gyis shes par bya'o/ /dbye na drug ste/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba nas yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'i bar ro/ /gzugs dang mig dbang dang de'i rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas mig gi 'dus te reg pas bcad pa dang mthun pa'i yul gyi 'gyur ba nyams su myong ba'i sems byung de/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du sgra rna ba de'i rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas zhes sogs dang gzhan la'ang sbyar te mtshan nyid shes par bya'o/ /tshor ba dang po lngas yul snang ba'i tshul gyis myong la/ phyi ma yid kyi rnam shes kyi 'khor du gyur pa'i tshor bas zhen pa'i tshul gyis myong ngo*/ /bdun pa khams la/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid dang 'bras bu 'dzin pa'am rgyu dang rigs byed pa'i chos te/ khams kyi don no/ /dbye na/ spyir dmigs pa yul gyi khams drug dang*/ rten dbang po'i drug dang*/ brten pa rnam shes kyi khams drug ste khams bco brgyad yod de/ gzugs nas chos khams kyi bar dang*/ mig nas yid khams kyi bar dang*/ mig gi rnam shes nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar ro/ /de dag gi khyad par ni sngar bshad pa rnams kyis shes la/

skabs 'di'i khams la drug yod de/ sa khams chu me rlung nam mkha' rnam shes kyi khams so/ /sra zhing 'thas pa nyid sa'i khams kyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du brlan zhing bsher ba chu'i khams dang*/ tsha zhing sreg pa me'i khams dang*/ yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi khams dang*/ thogs bcas kyi reg bya bkag tsam gyis phye ba nam mkha'i khams dang*/ yul gyi ngo bo dmigs pa tsam gyis rab tu phye ba'i rnam rig gi khams/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi mtshan nyid do/ /'di'i tsam sgras ni khyad par rig pa mi 'gog kyang dgos pa yod do/ /sa sogs 'byung ba bzhi mig shes kyi gzung bya min kyang*/ de'i kha dog ni mig shes kyi gzung yul yin te/ sa'i kha dog dang dbyibs rnams sa ma yin kyang*/ 'jig rten nas dkar bo dang ser bo sogs mthong zhes pa'i tha snyad byed pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ 'jig rten gyi ni tha snyad du/ kha dog dbyibs las zhes brjod/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar 'byung ba gzhan gsum la'ang 'gre'o/ /shing dang rdo dang lcags sogs la sra zhing 'thas pa yod pas na de dag sa'i khams yin nam min zhe na/ 'di la kha cig sa'i khams yin kyang sa min zhes gsungs mod/ de dag gi sra ba sa'i khams yin kyang ngo bo ni de'i rigs kyi 'byung gyur ram 'byung ba gang yin dpyad par bya ste/ 'byung ba yin na reg bya'i skye mched yin dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du 'o ma sogs dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od zer sogs dang*/ sprin sogs la'ang rim bzhin bsher ba dang*/ tsha ba dang g.yo ba yod pas zhib cha 'byed dgos/ bye brag smra bas gzugs kyi gong bu chung ngu zhig la'ang 'byung ba bzhi ka yod pa dang*/ sa chu me rlung re re la'ang 'degs pa dang bsil ba dang dro ba dang g.yo ba yod pas 'byung ba bzhi yod ces smra'o/ /brgyad pa rten 'brel la/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bltas nas grub pa ste/ rten 'brel gyi don no/

/skabs 'dir dbye na ma rig pa na rga shi'i bar bcu gnyis so/ /de dag gi khyad par rgyas par phye na mang du 'gyur bas bsdus te bshad na/ spyir ma rig pa la las 'bras dang bden bzhi dang rnam pa'i rab dbye dang de kho na nyid phra rags ci rigs la rmongs pa du ma yod na'ang*/ so skye'i rgyud kyi bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa 'dir yan lag dang po'o/ /ma rig pa des kun nas bslangs te bsags pa'i dge mi dge mi g.yo ba'i las gsum ni gnyis pa 'du byed pa'i las so/ /las de dag gi bag chags gang la bsgos pa'i tshe 'di'i rgyu dus kyi yid kyi rnam shes dang phyi mar nying mtshams sbyar ma thag pa'i 'bras dus kyi rnam shes gnyis ni gsum pa rnam shes so/ /nying mtshams sbyar ma thag pa'i rnam shes dang*/ tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed bzhi ni 'dir ming yin la de dang lhan cig pa'i mer mer bo ni gzugs te bzhi ba ming gzugs so// mer mer bo rim gyis 'phel nas mig sna sogs kyi ngo bo grub pa ni lnga ba skye mched do/ /de nas yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus te yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum yongs su gcod pa'i rig pa ni drug pa reg pa'o/ /reg pas yul bcad pa dang rjes su mthun par myong ba'i tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum ni bdun pa tshor ba'o/ /de nas tshor ba bde ba la mi 'bral ba dang*/ sdug bsngal la 'bral bar zhen pa ni brgyad pa sred pa'o/ /'dod yon dang lta ngan dang tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs ngan pa la chags pa ni dgu pa len pa'o/ / sngar gyi rgyu dus kyi rnam shes la gnyis pa 'du byed kyi bag chags bsgos pa sred len gnyis kyis gsos btab pas mthu can du gyur pa'i las ni bcu ba srid pa'o/ /de'i dbang gis skye gnas bzhi bo gang rung du rnam shes nying mtshams sbyar ba ni bcu gcig pa skye ba'o/ /phung bo smin cing gzhan du 'gyur ba ni rga ba yin la/

phung bo'i ris mthun dor ba ni shi ba ste bcu gnyis pa rga shi'o/ /rten 'brel tshar gcig gi tshe sred len srid pa gsum ni ming gzugs kyi sngon du 'byung ba yin na'ang*/ 'dir tshor ba'i rjes su bshad pa ni rten 'brel gzhan gyi skye rim bshad pa'o/ /de la gang gis 'phen na ma rig pas kun nas bslangs pa'i 'du byed kyis 'phen no/ /gang 'phangs na ming gzugs skye mched reg tshor ba nyer bzhi'o/ /ji ltar 'phangs na rnam shes la las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i tshul gyis so/ /gang gis 'grub na srid len srid pa gsum gyis so/ /gang 'grub na skye ba rga shi gnyis so/ /de dag kyang mtshon tsam ste rgyas par gzhan du blta'o/ /gnyis pa rnam byang phyogs la 'gres rkang gi dbang du byas te lnga bcu rtsa lngar bshad kyang*/ phyogs gtogs so sor phye na brgya dang bzhi drug ste/ phar phyin drug /stong nyid bco brgyad/ byang phyogs so bdun/ bden bzhi/ bsam gtan bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bzhi/ rnam par thar ba brgyad/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu/ rnam thar sgo gsum/ mngon par shes pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ gzungs kyi sgo/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi/ byams pa chen po/ snying rje chen po/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ gang zag rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong*/ phyir mi 'ong*/ dgra bcom/ rang sangs rgyas te bzhi/ thams cad shes pa nyid/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang bcas pa rnams te rim par 'chad do/ /dang po phar phyin la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sar phyin par byed pa'am phyin zin pa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi nyams len zhig go /dbye na drug ste/ der gyur pa'i sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar ro/ /dang po la ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /spyir gtong ba'i sems pa dang des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las ni sbyin pa yin la/

de sems bskyed bsngo ba shes rab gsum gyis zin pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin du 'gyur te gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ /dbye na/ chos dang*/ zang zing gi sbyin pa gnyis/ sbyin bya'i rdzas ni sbyin pa min pas gang la sbyin pa dang sbyin bya'i rdzas dang ji ltar sbyin pa gsum gyis shes dgos so/ /yang 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das gnyis te gzhan lnga la yang sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa tshul khrims la ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /spyir gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa ci rigs las phyir log pa'i spong sems ni/ tshul khrims yin la/ spong sems khyad par can gyi sa bon yang tshul khrims su 'dod pa yod/ dbye na nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum/ tshul khrims la gang bsrung ba dang gang gis srung ba dang ji ltar srung ba gsum gyis so/ /gsum pa bzod pa la ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /gnod byed la ji mi snyam pa dang sdug bsngal dang du len pa dang chos la nges par sems pas mos pa'i sems byung ni/ bzod pa yin la/ dbye na sngar ltar gsum yod/ 'di la'ang gang la bzod pa dang gang gis bzod pa dang ji ltar bzod pa gsum gyis so/ /bzhi pa brtson 'grus la/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dge ba'i bya ba la mngon par spro ba'i sems pa ni/ brtson 'grus yin la/ dbye na/ dge bsdud pa dang sems can don byed kyi brtson 'grus gnyis/ 'di la'ang brtsam bya dang rtsom byed dang ji ltar rtsom pa gsum gyis so/ /lnga ba bsam gtan la/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /rang gi dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig pa'i sems dge ba ni/ bsam gtan yin la/ dbye na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan gnyis so/ /'di la'ang gang la bsam gtan bya ba dang byed pa dang ji ltar byed pa'i tshul gsum gyis so/ /drug pa shes rab la/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /brtags pa'i dngos po la chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i sems byung ni/

shes rab yin la/ dbye na ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i shes rab gnyis sam/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i shes rab po/ /'di la'ang gang shes pa dang gang gis shes pa dang ji ltar shes pa'i tshul gsum gyis rig par bya'o/ /'jug pa'i ṭik+ka ltar na/ drug po de rnams zin byed sngar ltar dang*/ lam rim las/ de dag goms pa yongs su rdzogs pa na de dang de'i phar phyin 'gyur bar bshad de mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa stong nyid bco brgyad bshad pa la gnyis/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dgag bya bden grub bkag tsam gyis rab tu phye ba'i de bzhin nyid de/ stong nyid kyi don te mtshan nyid kyang yin no/ /dbye na nang stong ba nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong ba nyid kyi bar bco brgyad de/ de yang nang mig nas yid kyi bar skye mched drug bden pas stong ba dang stong ba nyid dang*/ phyi'i gzugs sogs bden stong phyi stong ba nyid dang*/ dbang rten khog pa lta bu ni shes rgyud kyis bsdus shing dbang bos ma bsdus pas de bden stong phyi nang stong ba nyid dang*/ stong nyid bden stong stong pa nyid stong ba nyid/ phyogs bcu bden stong chen po stong ba nyid dang*/ mya 'das bden stong don dam pa stong ba nyid dang*/ khams gsum po sogs 'dus byas bden stong 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang*/ nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas bden stong 'dus ma byas stong ba nyid dang*/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i dbus bden stong mtha' las 'das pa stong ba nyid dang*/ 'khor ba bden stong thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong ba nyid dang*/ theg chen dor byar med pa bden stong dor ba med pa stong ba nyid dang*/ de bzhin nyid bden stong rang bzhin stong ba nyid dang*/ khams bco brgyad la sogs pa'i chos thams cad bden stong chos thams cad stong ba nyid dang*/ gzugs gzugs rung gi mtshan nyid dang tshor ba myong ba'i mtshan nyid can sogs thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i mtshan nyid bden stong rang gi mtshan nyid stong ba nyid dang*/

'das pa sogs dus gsum bden stong mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang*/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pa bden stong dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong ba nyid de bcu drug go /bcu drug po de rnams ni yum gyi mdo las yang yang zlos te gsungs shing*/ nyi shur yang bshad de/ de nyid las/ rab 'byor gzhan yang dngos po ni dngos pos stong ngo*/ /dngos po med pa ni dngos po med pas stong ngo*/ /rang bzhin ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo*/ /gzhan gyi dngos po ni gzhan gyi dngos pos stong ngo*/ /zhes bshad do/ /de yang phung bo lnga bden stong dngos po stong ba nyid/ nam mkha' dang myang 'das sogs bden stong dngos po med pa stong ba nyid/ rang bzhin nam chos nyid bden stong rang bzhin stong ba nyid/ byed pa po gzhan gyis stong ba'i ngo bo nyid bden stong gzhan gyi ngo bo stong ba nyid do/ /bcu drug tu bshad pa ni blo ngo la la bltos te log rtog sel ba'i phyir rgyas pa'i dbang du byas la/ phyi ma bzhi don la ltos te bsdus nas gsungs pas mi 'gal zhing*/ shin tu bsdu na de thams cad dngos po stong ba nyid dang dngos po med pa stong ba nyid gnyis su 'du ba yin no/ /ming tsam gyis ngos bzung na de ltar yin kyang*/ stong nyid de rnams kyi don legs par go zhing rtogs pa ni dgag bya bden grub rigs pas khegs pa la rags las so/ /des na 'dir dgag gzhi dgag bya bkag pa gsum gyis shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa byang phyogs so bdun las/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ byang chub sgrub byed kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i lam mo/ /dbye na/ sde tshan bdun te/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba bzhi/ dbang bo lnga/ stobs lnga/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad do/ /dang po la/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bden bzhi gang rung gi blang dor la so sor dpyad cing 'dzin pa'i mkhyen pa zhig

go /dbye na bzhi ste/ nyer len gyi phung bos bsdus pa'i lus mi gtsang bar lta ba'i lus dran pa nyer gzhag /zag bcas kyi tshor ba sdug bsngal bar lta ba'i tshor ba dran pa nyer gzhag /sems skad cig gis skye 'jig byed pa'i mi rtag par lta ba'i sems dran pa nyer gzhag chos thams cad gang zag gi bdag med par lta ba'i chos dran pa nyer gzhag go /gnyis pa yang dag spong ba la/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bden bzhi gang rung gi blang dor la spro ba'i rang gi dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i mkhyen pa zhig go /dbye na bzhi ste/ mi dge ba'i phyogs skye 'gyur mi skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba dang*/ de bzhin du skyes zin spong bar byed pa dang*/ dge ba'i phyogs skye 'gyur bskyed par byed pa dang*/ skyes zin spel bar byed pa'i yang dag spong ba'o/ /gsum pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sprul sgyur sna tshogs kyi rten byed pa'i mkhyen pa zhig go /dbye na bzhi ste/ rdzu 'phrul dang ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa la dga' ba'i 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba dang*/ de la brtson pa'i brtson 'grus kyi de dang*/ de'i tshe sems rtse gcig pa'i sems pa'i de dang*/ de'i ched du chos rnam par 'byed pa'i dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba'o/ /bzhi pa dbang bo la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang 'bras 'phags lam bskyed pa la dbang byed pa'i mkhyen pa zhig go /dbye na lnga ste/ bden bzhi'i blang dor la yid ches pa'i dad pa'i dbang bo dang*/ de la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyi de dang*/ dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa'i de dang*/ sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi de dang*/ bden bzhi'i blang dor so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi dpang bo'o/ /lnga ba stobs la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang 'bras 'phags lam bskyed pa la dbang byed pa gong 'phel du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa zhig go

/dbye na lnga ste/ dad sogs dbang bo lnga'i gnas skabs gong 'phel du song ba'i dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab kyi stobs lnga'o/ /sa mtshams ni dran pa nyer gzhag sogs gsum ni tshogs lam nas thob cing*/ dbang bo dang stobs gnyis sbyor lam nas 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /drug pa byang chub kyi yan lag la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang 'bras byang chub kyi rgyu'am yan lag byed pa'i 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa zhig go /dbye na bdun ste/ bden pa la dmigs pa mi g.yeng ba'i dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed dang*/ nges par 'byung ba'i brtson 'grus dang*/ phan yon gyi dga' ba dang*/ lus sems las rung gi shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas btang snyoms byang chub kyi yan lag go /bdun pa 'phags lam la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags lam gyi cha shas sam/ rang 'bras 'phags lam gyi rgyu byed pa'i 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa zhig go /dbye na brgyad de/ chos nyid kyi don la dpyod pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ rang gis rtogs pa ltar ston par sems pa'i yang dag pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ ngag gi las rnam par dag pa'i yang dag pa'i ngag dang*/ lus kyi las rnam par dag pa'i yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang*/ log 'tsho spang ba'i yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang*/ sgom spang spong ba'i yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang*/ dmigs rnams mi brjed pa'i yang dag pa'i dran pa dang*/ yon tan khyad par can bsgrub pa'i ched du dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /bzhi ba la bden pa bzhi la gnyis/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /dbye na bzhi ste/ sdug bsngal bden pa/ kun 'byung*/ 'gog pa/ lam bden no/ /dang po sdug bden la/ dbye bzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/

/dang po ni/ rang rgyu las nyon gyis dbang gis byung ba'i rigs su gnas pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bden pa'o/ /dbye na/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum/ dang po ni/ tshor ba sdug bsngal chen po thams cad/ gnyis pa ni/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba phal cher/ gsum pa ni/ nyer len gyi phung bo lta bu'o/ /mdor na las nyon gyis byung ba'i ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten dang ma dag pa'i bcud kyi sems can dang de'i phung bo ni sdug bsngal bden pa'o/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /rang 'bras sdug bden bskyed byed kyi rigs su gnas pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'i bden pa'o/ /dbye na/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis/ dang po ni/ zag bcas kyi dge mi dge mi g.yo ba'i las rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma dag pa'i so skye'i rgyud kyi 'dod chags zhe sdang khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa sogs rtsa ba dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams so/ /gsum pa 'gog bden la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lam bden gyi stobs kyis thob pa'i bral ba'o/ /dbye na/ theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden rnams so/ /bzhi ba lam bden la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gog bden thob byed kyi thabs su gyur pa'i 'phags lam mo/ /dbye na/ 'phags lam thams cad do/ /phyi ma gnyis kyi don bsdu na/ 'phags pa'i lam gang gis rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya mthong spang dang sgom spang de rang gi sems kyi steng du slar skye mi rung ba'i tshul gyis bkag pa'i sems kyi chos nyid la 'gog bden zhes bya la/ 'phags lam de nyid la lam bden zhes bya'o/ /'khor bar 'jug rim gyi dbang du byas nas kun 'byung las sdug bsngal 'byung bas de gnyis bstan la/ 'khor ba las ldog rim gyi dbang du byas nas lam bden la brten nas 'gog bden 'thob par 'gyur bas de gnyis bzhag pa ste/

de'i dang po gnyis dor bya dang*/ phyi ma gnyis blang bya'o/ /lnga ba bsam gtan la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi 'og sa 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po gsum gang rung la chags pa ci rigs dang bral byed dam bral bas rab tu phye ba gang rung gis bsdus pa'i gong sa'i snyoms 'jug zhig go /'di la dbye na bzhi ste/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi ba'o/ khyad par la zhi ba na mang yang bsdu na/ rang gi 'og sa 'dod pa la chags pa ci rigs dang bral byed dam bral bas rab tu phye ba'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po dang*/ de bzhin du bsam gtan dang po dang de gnyis pa dang gsum pa la chags pa ci rigs dang bral byed dam bral bas rab tu phye ba'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa rnams ni/ rim pa bzhin bsam gtan gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi ba'i snyoms 'jug go /'dir bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug bzhi dang*/ de'i gnas bzhi yod pa rnams khyad par phyed par bya'o/ /drug pa tshad med pa la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bsam gtan la brten nas skyes shing dmigs pa dang 'bras bu tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sems pa'o/ /dbye na bzhi ste/ byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms tshad med de/ rim pa bzhin du sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god 'dod kyi byams pa tshad med dang*/ sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang ldan na dga' ba'i dga' ba dang*/ chags sdang dang bral na snyam pa'i btang snyoms tshad med rnams so/ /bdun pa gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi 'og sa gzugs dang gzugs med dang po gsum so so la chags pa ci rigs dang bral byed dam bral bas rab tu phye ba gang rung gis bsdus pa'i gong ma'i snyoms 'jug go /dbye na bzhi ste/ sbyor ba'i tshe gzugs kyi 'du shes ni rags pa dang nam mkha'i 'du shes ni zhi ba'o snyam du lta zhing goms pa'i gzugs med nam mkha'i snyoms 'jug dang*/

nam mkha'i 'du shes kyang rags pa dang rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni zhi ba'o snyam du lta zhing goms pa'i rnam shes kyi snyoms 'jug dang*/ rnam shes kyi 'du shes kyang rags pa dang dmigs pa tsam nas ci yang med do snyam du lta zhing goms pa'i ci yang med kyi snyoms 'jug dang*/ ci yang med pa'i 'du shes kyang rags pa dang*/ blo ngor 'du shes rags pa mngon gyur ni yod pa yang min phra ba med pa yang min no snyam du lta zhing goms pa'i srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug rnams so/ /brgyad pa rnam par thar ba la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang sa'i nyon mongs kyis ma bslad cing thar ba don gnyer gyis bsam pas zin pa'i snyoms 'jug go /dbye na brgyad de/ sngar bshad pa ltar gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bzhis bsdus pa'i rnam thar bzhi dang*/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar dang*/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar dang*/ gegs sel sdug pa'i rnam thar dang*/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar ro/ /phyi ma bzhi ni rim pa bzhin du/ nang rang lus la gzugs kyi 'du shes bzhag ste phyi'i gzugs la dmigs nas sprul sgyur byed pa dang*/ rang lus la gzugs med pa'i 'du shes bzhag ste phyi'i gzugs la dmigs nas sprul sgyur byed pa dang*/ gzugs sdug mi sdug phan tshun bltos par bsams te mthar gzugs thams cad sdug par mos pa dang*/ tshor ba dang 'du shes rags pa bkag pa'i 'gog pa'i rnam thar te bzhi'o/ /dgu ba mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa snga ma nas phyi ma la rim gyis 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug khyad par can zhig go /dbye na dgu ste/ sngar ltar bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug khyad par can bzhi ste brgyad dang*/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gcig go /bcu ba rnam par thar ba'i sgo la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag med phra rags dang mi rtag sogs ci rigs la dmigs pa'i sgo nas mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po byed pa'i snyoms 'jug zhig go

/dbye na gsum ste/ stong ba dang bdag med pa la dmigs pa'i rnam par thar ba'i sgo stong ba nyid dang*/ 'gog lam la dmigs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa dang*/ mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis kun 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi la dmigs pa'i rnam par thar ba'i sgo smon pa med pa'o/ /'di dag ni sgrib pa ci rigs las grol bar byed pa'am thar ba'i sgo yin pas na/ rnam par thar ba'i sgo'o/ /bcu gcig pa mngon par shes pa la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sbyor byung ngam skye bas thob cing yul rang stobs kyis mngon sum du rig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /dbye na drug ste/ sprul sgyur sna tshogs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang*/ gzugs phra rags mngon sum du mthong ba'i lha'i mig gi mngon shes dang sgra phra rags mthong ba'i lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes dang*/ rang gzhan gyi tshe sngon gyi gnas sam tshe rabs du ma rtogs pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes dang*/ gang zag gzhan gyi sems gyi rgyu tshul rtogs pa'i gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes dang*/ sgrib gnyis spong ba'i thabs dang spangs pa ci rigs mngon sum rtogs pa'i zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes rnams so/ /de dag ni mngon shes kyi gtso bo yin la/ gzhan yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mang du yod do/ /mngon shes ni mngon sum du bshad pas/ rang gzhan gyi byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur ci rigs snang la ma nges pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa 'ga' zhig mngon shes min la/ rtags sam mtshan ma 'ga' la brten nas byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur 'ga' zhig rig pa ni rtog pa yin pas/ mngon shes min kyang blun pos ni mngon shes su 'dzin no/ /bcu gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin la dbye ba dang*/ dbye gzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ yang dag pa'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i sems byung ngo*/ /dbye ba ni yum gyi mdo las grangs mang du bshad cing*/

ji lta ji snyed la dmigs dmigs pa gnyis dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi bar chad med lam dang rnam grol dang mi slob pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /spyir sngags rim du dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig pa zhig byung na rgyun ring thung gang yin kyang ting nge 'dzin yin zhes bshad la/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par ba ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis bsdus pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gis bsdus pa rnams so/ /bcu gsum pa gzungs kyi sgo la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ zhi gnas dang mtshungs ldan gyi dran pa dang shes rab kyis bsdus pa'i rig pa khyad par can no/ /dbye na gsum ste bzod pa'i gzungs dang*/ gsang sngags kyi gzungs dang*/ tshig don gyi gzungs so/ /dang po ni/ gnas lugs stong nyid kyi don la mi skrag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdig pa sogs zhi bar byed nus pa'i gsang sngags rtsom nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab bo/ /gsum pa ni/ tshig don bskal bar mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab bo/ /'di dag ni sbyor lam bzod pa nas 'thob kyi/ de'i gong du min no/ /gzungs kyi tshig la gzungs zhes brjod pa ni/ rjod byed la brjod bya'i ming gis btags pa'o/ /a la sogs pa'i yi ge'i don de dang de rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgoms pas gzungs de dag skye bas na gzungs kyi sgo'o/ /bcu bzhi ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gdul bya'i mi mthun phyogs 'joms par byed pa la stobs dang ldan pas rab tu phye ba'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa ste/ 'dir stobs so/ /dbye na/ bcu ste/ rgyu dge mi dge byas pa las 'bras bu bde sdug ma nor ba 'byung ba gnas dang*/ nor nas 'byung ba gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang*/ las kyi 'bras bu'i dbye ba ma lus par rtogs pa'i las kyi rnam smin mkhyen pa dang*/

mngon mtho dang nges legs gsum po gang la mos pa'i mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams rigs sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa dang*/ dbang bo rno 'bring rtul gsum gyi khyad par ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa dang*/ mngon mtho dang theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa dang*/ sngon dang phyi ma'i tshe rabs rnams su 'chi 'pho byas pa dang byed pa rnams mkhyen pa gnyis dang*/ sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs pa'i spangs pa mkhyen pa'i zag pa zad pa mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i stobs rnams so/ /bco lnga ba mi 'jigs pa la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dbye ba ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi don gang mngon du byas shing rtogs par zhal gyis 'ches pa la mi 'jigs pa'i mkhyen pa mthar thug ste/ 'dir mi 'jigs pa'o/ /dbye na bzhi ste/ rang don gyi dbang du byas te nga nyid chos thams cad la mngon par sangs rgyas so zhes zhal gyis 'ches pa la 'di thugs su ma chud zhes chos mthun gyi rgol ba med pas rtogs pa phun tshogs bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa dang*/ gzhan don gyi dbang du byas na sgrib gnyis kyis thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob pa bar chad byed par bstan pa la de mi byed do zhes rgol ba med pas bar chad kyi chos bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa dang*/ gzhi shes dang lam shes bsgoms pas thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes bstan pa la de mi nus so zhes rgol ba med pas nges par 'byung ba bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa dang*/ ngas sgrib pa ma lus pa spangs so zhes dam bcas pa la 'di ma spangs so zhes rgol ba med pas spangs pa phun tshogs bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /bcu drug pa so so yang dag par rig pa la dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'chad bya 'chad byed kyi don la thogs pa med pas rab tu phye ba'i mkhyen pa'o/

/dbye na bzhi ste/ chos rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs mtha' dag la mkhyen pa thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab ni chos so so yang dag par rig pa dang*/ de bzhin du chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid thams cad thogs med du mkhyen pa'i chos so so yang dag rigs pa dang*/ skad kyi rigs sna tshogs dang mthun par smra bar nus pa'i nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag rig pa dang*/ chos rnams kyi rnam dbye ma lus pa chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa rnams so/ /bcu bdun pa byams pa chen po la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ 'dir bsam gtan la brten nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa dang bde ba 'god par 'dod pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /dbye na/ spyir sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan na snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ bde ba la 'god par 'dod pa'i byams pa gnyis yod kyang*/ 'dir byams pa chen po ni/ sems can thams cad gtan gyi bde ba la rang nyid kyis khur du bzhes nas 'god par byed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa zhig go /bco brgyad pa snying rje chen po la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ 'dir sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral ba'am skyob par 'dod pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /dbye na/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na snyam pa dang*/ bral bar bya'o snyam pa'i snying rje gnyis yod kyang*/ 'di'i snying rje chen po ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal mtha' dag las skyob par khur du bzhes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa zhig go /nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas kyi snying rje gsum la khyad par ci yod ce na/ rten gyi sgo nas kyang khyad par yod mod/ sangs rgyas kyi snying rje ni/ dper na/ rkang dang*/ byang sems kyi snying rje ni rus pa dang*/ nyan rang gi snying rje ni sha dang mtshungs par mdo las bshad pa ltar khyad par yod do/ /bcu dgu ba sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la dbye gzhi dang*/

dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa 'og ma ba dang rtogs rigs ma 'dres pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'o/ /dbye na bco brgyad de/ spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug /rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug /'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum rnams so/ /dang po drug ni/ sku las 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba'i spyod pa ma 'dres pa dang*/ de bzhin du gsung la ca co mi mnga' ba dang*/ thugs dran pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba dang*/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba dang*/ blang dor bden par tha dad du 'dzin pa mi mnga' ba dang*/ dus la bab ma bab ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms mi mnga' ba'i ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa drug ni/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa la 'dun pa'i rtogs pa ma 'dres pa dang*/ de bzhin du gdul bya'i don du gshegs pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ gdul bya 'dul ba mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa'i ting 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab dang*/ sgrib pa spangs pa las mi nyams pa'i ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las ma 'dres pa'i ye shes gsum mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ dus gsum chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum mo/ /nyi shu ba rgyun du zhugs pa la/ zhugs pa dang*/ 'bras gnas gnyis kyi dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ mthong spangs kun sbyor gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i lam sgom pa'i rgyun la zhugs pa'i nyan thos so/ /'di'i kun sbyor gsum ni/ 'jig lta kun brtags dang*/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang*/ the tshom kun btags so/ /dbye na der gyur pa'i dbang bo rno rtul gnyis so/ /sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam nas mthong lam rnam grol lam ma thob tshun chad du'o/ / gnyis pa 'bras gnas la mtshan nyid/

dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ / dang po ni/ de lta bu'i 'bras bu la gnas pa'i nyan thos so/ /dbye na/ der gyur pa'i spang bya gcig car ba dang rim gyis pa gnyis so/ /sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos mthong lam rnam grol lam nas nyan thos dgra bcom thob kha ma'i bar du'o/ /nyer gcig pa lan cig phyir 'ong la zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas gnyis kyi dang po la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs drug pa mngon gyur pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson zhing 'dod par skye ba gcig len pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyan thos so/ /dbye na der gyur pa'i thod rgal ba dang mthar gyis pa gnyis so/ /sa mtshams la/ thod rgal ba'i zhugs pa ni nyan thos kyi sbyor lam nas mthong lam rnam grol lam ma thob bar dang*/ mthar gyis pa ni sgom lam thob pa nas 'dod nyon dgu pa dngos su spong ba'i bar du'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras gnas la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ de 'dra'i 'bras bu la gnas pa'i nyan thos so/ /dbye na sngar ltar gnyis so/ /sa mtshams la thod rgal ba ni mthong lam pa dang*/ mthar gyis pa ni 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pa'i sgom lam nas dgu ba dngos su spong ba'i bar du'o/ /nyer gnyis pa phyir mi 'ong la zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas gnyis kyi dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ 'dod nyon dgu pa mngon gyur pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i nyan thos so/ /dbye na/ de la der gyur pa'i chags bral sngon song dang mthar gyis pa gnyis so/ /sa mtshams la/ chags bral sngon song ni mthong lam tshun dang*/ mthar gyis pa ni/ 'dod nyon bdun pa spong ba'i sgom lam nas 'dod nyon dgu pa dngos su spong ba'i bar du'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras gnas la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po/ de 'dra'i 'bras bu la gnas pa'i nyan thos so/

/dbye na/ sngar ltar gnyis te/ rgyas par phye na mang du yod do/ /sa mtshams la/ chags bral sngon song ni mthong lam pa dang*/ mthar gyis pa ni/ 'dod nyon dgu ba spangs pa nas srid nyon dgu ba dngos su spong ba'i bar du'o/ /nyer gsum pa dgra bcom skor la/ zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas gnyis kyi dang po la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs dgu ba spangs pas rab tu bye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i nyan thos so/ /dbye na gcig char ba dang rim gyis pa'i dgra bcom zhugs pa gnyis so/ /sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam thob nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar du'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras gnas la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ de 'dra'i 'bras bu la gnas pa'i nyan thos so/ /'di dang nyan thos dgra bcom pa gnyis don gcig /dbye na sngar ltar dgra bcom pa gnyis so/ /sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi mi slob lam kho na'o/ /nyer bzhi ba rang sangs rgyas la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang don du thar ba don gnyer gtso bor byed pa'i theg pa 'bring bo'i gang zag go /rang sangs rgyas zhes pa ni/ srid pa tha ma'i tshe slob dpon gzhan gyi man ngag la mi brten par rang stobs kyis myang 'das mngon du byed pas de skad ces bya'o/ /dbye na/ bse ru lta bu dang tshogs spyod che chung gi rang rgyal gnyis te gsum mo/ /nyer lnga ba thams cad shes pa nyid la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa dngos dang theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ / 'di dang gzhi shes gnyis don gcig /dbye na theg pa gsum gyi gzhi shes rnam pa gsum mo/ /nyer drug pa lam shes pa nyid la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ theg pa gsum gyi lam bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang thabs khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen

pa'o/ /'di dang theg chen 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs gnyis don gcig /nyer bdun pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /'di dang sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa gnyis don gcig dbye na/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis te/ rgyas par phye na mang du dogs pas re zhig de tsam mo/ /smras pa/ gsung rab spyi dang sher phyin mdo nyid kyi/ /dngos bstan 'gres rkang ji snyed yod gyur ba'i/ /don rnams thogs med sku mched rnam gnyis sogs/ /mkhas pa'i bzhed srol dpang bzhag legs par bkral/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis/ /'dzin par mdzad pa'i tshul de ches dka' yang*/ /yum gyi dgongs pa 'grel bar rab bsams te/ /nyung ngu'i tshig gis rgya che'i gnas kun bsdus/ /thub pa'i gsung rab dgongs don nam mkha' bzhin/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i mkhyen mchog nyi zla bzhin/ /deng dus mkhas rlom rnam dpyod rgyu skar bzhin/ /bdag 'dra'i blo gros nyams chung me 'khyer bzhin/ / gzur gnas blo ldan gang gis 'di mthong tshe/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar ston par nges mod kyang*/ /gzhan dag snying la zug rngu sbyin pa'am/ /kun du rmongs pa'i rtog pa 'thob 'gyur sems/ /grogs dag tshul 'di lta bu'i legs bshad kyi/ /bdud rtsi myong ba'i dga' bdes rol gyis na/ /bstan la zhugs pa'i dgos pa mchis srid kyi/ /de min rab tu byung ba'i dgos pa gang*/ /rgya mtsho'i dbus na yid bzhin nor bu rdo/ /ma la ya na tsan dan nags tshal bzhin/ kha che'i yul na gur gum rtswa lta bu/ /gling gzhan 'ga' na gser dngul sa rdo bzhin/ /snying bo med la snying bor mthong ba yi/ /tshul 'dis rang cag thams cad bslus pa ste/ /des na rab tu byung bas don gang la/ /snying bor 'dzin pa'i gnas de shes par gyis/ /'dir 'bad legs par bshad las thob pa'i dges/

/tshe rabs kun du dal ba'i rten rnyed nas/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /'dzin la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhin shog /ces pa 'di'ang skyid thang gnas brtan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang zhes bgyi bas zhon rta'i gnang sbyin bcas mthun rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ bshad sgrub ming can gyis legs par bgyis pa ste mtshan nyid sogs la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba cung zad re ni yod do/ /bkra shis/ shu baṃ/ dge legs 'phel lo// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/yum gyi mdo'i 'gres rkang gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs bzhugs/ - PAGE 62-- PAGE 33-- PAGE 32-
